facts.business: Prakash Pipes Limited manufactures PVC pipes and fittings for water supply, sanitation, irrigation, and housing segments.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Higher volumes were expected to lift operating margins to 13.5–14%, partly reversing the 130-basis-point decline recorded in the previous fiscal.

key_risks: rising inflation weighing on private consumption
elevated oil and gas prices and gas rationing dampening investment activity
prolonged energy supply disruptions including gas rationing threatening to constrain production, raise inflation and hurt agricultural output through reduced fertiliser supply
elevated trade policy uncertainty weighing on exports and investment
